description: Run all the CI code-analysis gates locally against a change, before opening a PR, so failures are caught in seconds instead of after a full pipeline cycle. Use when the user says "run the gates", "check before I push", "will CI pass", "run the CI checks locally", "did I break a gate", or "pre-PR check", or as the verification step at the end of a change. Do NOT use to evaluate a skill's quality (that is governance-validate-skills) or to validate only the artifact graph and docs wiki (that is governance-check-graph); this runs the whole gate set the pipeline runs.
